city_status.summary_sr: Vazduh u Beogradu je dobrog kvaliteta.
city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is good.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorovo objašnjenje o potražnji vezanoj za bolnicu: promena prikazanog broja slobodnih mesta kod VMA sa 558 na 128 nema vreme merenja, pa ne može da potvrdi jutarnji priliv. Sada vidim prijem SEPA podataka pre 54 min naspram prijema građanskih senzora pre 4 min, ali starost prijema ne utvrđuje starost SEPA merenja. Ne mogu da pretvorim izveštaj Studija B o miru u Pionirskom parku u dokaz o bolničkom parkingu. [F6][F2][F4][F9]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector's hospital-demand explanation: VMA's displayed change from 558 to 128 has no measurement time, so it cannot establish a morning influx [F6]. I now see SEPA reception 54 min ago against citizen reception 4 min ago, but reception age does not establish SEPA measurement age [F2][F4]. I cannot turn Studio B's report of calm in Pionirski park into evidence about hospital parking [F9][F6].
